title: Negative — a ROLLBACK that leaves row-level security switched on
description: Enables row-level security on public.profiles and then runs a rollback that disables it on public.farms, which already had it off -- so the statement succeeds, changes nothing, and leaves profiles protected by RLS with no policies attached. That end state is worse than either intended one: with RLS on and no policy, every non-superuser read returns zero rows, which reads as 'no data' rather than as an error. RLS is a boolean on pg_class rather than an object, so only the rls branch of the snapshot can see this. Guards migration 51, which is almost entirely ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY statements.
